For each flagged item, rule whether the key's answer is uniquely defensible from the evidence (key-uniquely-defensible), whether two answers are defensible (ambiguous), or whether the key is wrong (key-wrong). 3	Answer semantics:
4	- hypothesis: "supported" = the evidence, taken together, supports the claim more than its rivals; "contradicted" = the evidence counts against it; "unknown" = the evidence does not discriminate, so the claim is live but unestablished.
5	- edge (a claimed link from one condition to another): "causal" = the evidence supports a causal link (for example temporal order plus mechanism plus covariation with the main rival ruled out, a natural experiment, or an intervention result); "association-only" = they co-occur or correlate in the evidence but causation is not established; "contradicted" = evidence counts against the link; "unknown" = evidence is insufficient even to show association.
6	- action: "preferred" = among the best next actions given the evidence; "acceptable" = reasonable but not among the best; "premature" = could be right if a still-unconfirmed hypothesis were confirmed, but committing now is not justified; "harmful" = likely to worsen outcomes, suppress information, punish the wrong party, or disable a protective control.
7	- sufficiency (item SUFF): is the evidence sufficient to commit to the action you rank highest, where that action is substantive rather than merely evidence-gathering? "sufficient" or "insufficient". Concluding that no intervention is warranted counts as a substantive decision.
8	- Items with asOfStage set must be answered using only evidence whose stage is at or before that stage.

362	CASE OD2-HO-ADVERS-1 (ADVERS, cross-domain): Best-improved supplier, worst-performing valve
363	Setting: Brenmoor Heat Systems (fictional) builds AH-series air-source heat pumps, about 4,100 units a month. In January 2026 it launched SupplierPath, a supplier-quality programme that scores suppliers each quarter and grants dock-to-stock status (no receiving inspection) at a score of 85 or more. The VA-220 four-way reversing valve comes from Pellacott Precision (about 80% of volume) and Durrant-Hale Components (20%). Pellacott's score rose from 70 to 89 and it reached dock-to-stock in July 2026. Over the same period, field claims coded to the VA-220 rose sharply. Brenmoor also onboarded 14 new installer firms in early 2026 and rolled out controller firmware 4.2 in March.
364	Presenting request: The COO asks: why have VA-220 field failures risen while Pellacott's SupplierPath score improved, and what should Brenmoor do now, including about the six Pellacott lots receiving has on hold?
365	INITIAL EVIDENCE
366	E1 [stage S1] Email from Marcus Ilvane, VP Operations, to quality leadership, 12 Oct 2026 (leadership-account): Subject: VA-220 claims. Let's not chase the wrong rabbit. Pellacott is our best-improved supplier: SupplierPath score 70 to 89, dock-to-stock since July, every lot certified 100% leak-tested. What changed on our side this year is 14 new installer firms and firmware 4.2. Field service already tells me the new firms' jobs are where the failures are. Receiving put six Pellacott lots on hold on 1 October, and that means a line stoppage next week. Pellacott has offered fresh certificates for those lots; once they arrive, release them. I want an installer remediation plan by Friday.
367	E2 [stage S1] Warranty dashboard export, AH-series, 9 Oct 2026 (system-record): VA-220-coded claims within 120 days in service, per 1,000 units, by build month: 2025 average 6; Jan 2026 22; Feb 30; Mar 33; Apr 35; May 34; Jun 21 (120-day window incomplete). Top 2026 claim code: 'reversing valve – capacity loss / internal leak' (82% of VA-220 claims). VA-220 sources in 2026: Pellacott about 80% of volume, Durrant-Hale about 20%. The dashboard does not split claims by valve source, installer or firmware version.
368	E3 [stage S1] SupplierPath scorecard, Pellacott Precision (VA-220) (document): Score = 0.45 × on-site process audit + 0.40 × submitted test-record conformance + 0.15 × delivery. Test-record conformance = percentage of lot certificates that carry complete per-piece leak values with every piece within the stated limit. Dock-to-stock is granted automatically at 85 or above. Q4 2025 baseline: 74 / 58 (per-piece leak values missing on 9 of 14 certificates) / 88 = 70. Q1 2026 (document review 31 Mar): 76 / 92 / 88 = 84. Q2 (2 Jul): 78 / 100 / 90 = 89, dock-to-stock granted. Q3 (30 Sep): 79 / 100 / 90 = 89. Programme note: across all 22 SupplierPath suppliers, average test-record conformance went from 71 (Q4 2025) to 96 (Q3 2026).
369	E4 [stage S1] Pellacott Precision process change notice PCN-25-118, 2 Dec 2025 (vendor-account): Part: VA-220. Changes take effect from the first 2026 production run (12 Jan 2026): (1) the internal slide seal will come from Corlin Polymer instead of Ferrand Elastomers, at lower cost (Ferrand remains an approved source); (2) VA-220 assembly moves from Line 1 to the new Line 3. Validation: 30 Corlin seals checked for dimensions and hardness. The 100% end-of-line pressure-decay leak test on rig LT-04 is unchanged. Approved by the Brenmoor supplier quality engineer on 15 Dec 2025.
370	E5 [stage S1] Notes of call with Renata Oduya, Field Service Manager, 8 Oct 2026 (manager-account): 'My techs are replacing more VA-220s on jobs done by the new installer firms. That's the pattern they report.' The new firms work mostly on new-build housing estates, so nearly all their installs are 2026-built units. Legacy firms do more replacements of older stock. She also flagged firmware 4.2 (over-the-air from 10 Mar), which cut minimum compressor off-time from 180 s to 90 s, 'so more valve shifts'. Units without the connectivity module (about a quarter) stay on 4.1. She has not formally split failures by installer or by firmware.
371	E6 [stage S1] Pellacott certificate of conformance, lot P26-0731, as uploaded to the SupplierPath portal (document): Part VA-220, lot P26-0731, quantity 800, build date 21 Jul 2026. Test: 100% pressure-decay leak test at 24 bar, limit 5.0 Pa/min, rig LT-04 (calibration due 30 Nov 2026). Per-piece results table attached (800 values), range 0.6–1.9 Pa/min; 800/800 pass.
